basic_info.description: Exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence at Montgomery Washington Tower, one of only 32 exclusive units. This nearly 2,000 SF single-level condo sits atop prestigious Jackson Square, walking distance to FiDi, Ferry Building, Chinatown, and North Beach. Unit #2505 offers dramatic southwest views of Downtown, Nob Hill, and towards Twin Peaks from every room. Interior features include wide plank hardwood floors, renovated gourmet chef's kitchen with Neolith counters / backsplash and stainless appliances, cozy gas fireplace, wet bar, and recessed lighting. The thoughtful layout includes a dedicated home office with built-ins and separate laundry room with washer/dryer. Building amenities feature 24-hour security, concierge services, lap pool, sundeck, private health club, and elegant lobby with high-speed elevators. This remarkable residence combines penthouse sophistication with prime San Francisco location, offering luxury, convenience, and spectacular city views in one of the city's most historic neighborhoods.
